title: WashU to adopt Okanagan Charter, strengthening commitment to health, well-being
summary_en: WashU will formally adopt the Okanagan Charter, reinforcing the university’s commitment to making health and well-being an integral part of campus culture and decision-making.
title_cn: WashU to adopt Okanagan Charter, strengthening commitment to health, well-being

title: ICC sanctions threaten academic freedom, legal education
summary_en: The United States imposed sweeping new sanctions against the International Criminal Court (ICC) Oct. 9, following up on sanctions imposed last year. They are threatening academic freedom, limiting opportunities for law students and making it harder for scholars to engage with international legal institutions, WashU law professor Leila Sadat argues.
title_cn: ICC sanctions threaten academic freedom, legal education

title: In plants, sense of time is connected with sense of danger
summary_en: A well-known clock gene helps plants sense salt and respond to it, according to new research from biologist Xuehua Zhong in WashU Arts & Sciences. The findings could help scientists develop more resilient crops.
title_cn: In plants, sense of time is connected with sense of danger

title: Osteoarthritis therapy study advances with $17 million from ARPA-H
summary_en: The funding will support a WashU Medicine collaboration with CRISPR Therapeutics and SynGenix, a WashU startup, to move a single-injection treatment to reverse joint damage into clinical trials.
title_cn: Osteoarthritis therapy study advances with $17 million from ARPA-H
